article_content: A 41-year-old Asian elephant named Maude died suddenly at Zoo Miami after suffering from severe constipation. She collapsed and passed away within a minute during a morning treatment session on Wednesday. A necropsy revealed her intestines were completely blocked by sand and clay — substances elephants sometimes ingest naturally in the wild, but which proved fatal in Maude’s case due to her pre-existing health conditions. Veterinarians had been treating Maude for days after she stopped eating and producing feces — a dramatic change from the typical 400 pounds of waste an adult elephant produces daily. Treatment attempts included wheat bran, intravenous fluids, and other interventions, but none succeeded. Her arthritis, which limited her movement, likely contributed to the severity of the impaction. Ron Magill, Zoo Miami’s communications director, described the event as 'very abrupt and traumatic' for staff, noting that elephants are highly intelligent and emotionally resonant animals. A more comprehensive necropsy is planned to further investigate the cause and implications for elephant care in captivity.
translated_content: Elefan asien nan 41 ane Maude mouri subitman nan Zoo Miami aprè te soufri nan konstipasyon sevyè. Li tombe ak mouri nan piti piti minit la pandan yon sesyon tretman maten lan, merkredi. Yon nèkopsi te revele ke intèstin li te totalman bloke pa sann ak argil — matriyè ki gen pou yo konsome natirèlman nan moun sa a, men ki te fata pou Maude a a cause de kondisyon sante li deja prezan. Vetènèyè yo te tret Maude pandan jou yo aprè li te kòmanse pa manje ak fè kaka — chanjman dramatik pa rapò ak 400 pa nouvo kaka ki gen pou yo fè jounen an nan yon elefan adlt. Tretman yo te inplike bran d bl, likid IV, ak lòt entèvansyon, men pa yon sèl sa ki te reyisi. Artritis li, ki limitè moviman li, te probablman kontribye nan gravite bloka a. Ron Magill, direktè komikasyon Zoo Miami, te dekri evènman sa a kòm 'très subit ak tramatik' pou ekipaj la, ak moun yo te di ke elefan yo se anpil entèlijan ak gen yon rezonans emosyonèl fòt. Yon nèkopsi plis komplè a pral fèt pou analize pi fòt koz ak implikasyon yo pou sovjèn elefan nan konfinman.

article_content: Dennis Rader, known as the BTK killer, is collaborating with author and forensic psychologist Katherine Ramsland on a non-fiction book exploring his criminal mindset. At 69, he is serving ten consecutive life sentences for the murders of ten people in Wichita, Kansas, between 1974 and 1991. He earned the nickname 'BTK'—short for 'Bind, Torture, Kill'—because of his signature modus operandi, none of which his wife, Paula, knew about until his arrest. In a handwritten letter dated September 29 from his cell at the El Dorado Correctional Facility in Kansas, Rader revealed he is working with Katherine Ramsland on a book intended to aid victims’ families financially and advance understanding of criminal psychology. 'The main reason for the book is to help the VF's monetarily,' he wrote. 'I can never replace their loved ones; my deeds are too dark to comprehend. But the book—or films—is the only way I can help them.' Rader emphasized that he does not intend to profit from the project. 'I mean to burn no bridges and hope someday to open up. People like me need to be understood, so the criminal justice field can better comprehend the criminal mind. That would be my way of paying my debt to society.' However, Rader is legally barred from profiting from his crimes, as confirmed by a 2005 court settlement following lawsuits from victims’ families. Ramsland insists the book will be scholarly and non-sensationalist, with no financial benefit to Rader. Meanwhile, Rader’s daughter, Kerri Rawson, 36, has publicly condemned the 2014 film 'A Good Marriage,' directed by Peter Askin and based on a 2010 short story by Stephen King. Although King has stated the film was inspired by the BTK case, Rawson argues it exploits the trauma of the victims and their families—including her own. 'He’s exploiting my father’s ten victims and their families,' she told The Kansas City Star. 'My father is not worth all the books, news stories, and attention.' Rader responded to his daughter’s criticism with regret: 'I’m sorry my daughter is upset. I would be too.' He reiterated that his wife and children knew nothing of his crimes: 'The family knew nothing about my dark deeds. I carried that secret until the day I was arrested.'
translated_content: Dennis Rader, ki konnen kòm tèt BTK, ap travay ak ekriyen ak psikoloj fònèsik Katherine Ramsland sou yon liv nonfiksyon ki analize espris kriminel li. An 69, li ap sèvi dek sèlman peyi konsekativ pou mòt yo de dix moun nan Wichita, Kansas, ant 1974 ak 1991. Li te resevwa sèl la 'BTK'—ki fèt pou 'Lien, Tak, Tèt'—poukisa li te pratike modus operandi sa a, ki pa janm konn pa fèm li Paula, jiska li te areste. Nan yon let ekriv men, daté 29 septanm, nan kamer li nan El Dorado Correctional Facility nan Kansas, Rader te deklere li ap travay avèk Katherine Ramsland sou yon liv ki vle aji fami viktim yo finansyèman ak amelyore konpreyansyon espris kriminel. 'Poukisa m ap fè liv sa a se pou aji VF yo finansyèman,' li ekri. 'M pa ka remplace timoun yo; mes yo twò nwa pou komprann. Men liv sa a—oubyen fim yo—se sèlman mwayen m gen pou aji yo.' Rader te mete an fèn li pa vle fè pwofit nan projè sa a. 'M vle pa kase pont yo, epi espere yon jou m ta kapab ouvri m. Moun tankou m bezwen pou konprann, pou domèn jisitis kriminel la kapab konprann pi byen espris kriminel. Sa a se mwayen m pou remet debye m avèk sosiété a.' Menm jan, Rader pa kapab fè pwofit nan krimen yo, tankou konfime pa yon takt 2005 aprè lèt viktim yo. Ramsland te asire liv sa a pral syantifik ak pa sensasyonalis, ak pa gen okenn pwofit pou Rader. Pendant sa, fi Rader, Kerri Rawson, 36, te kondemne fim 2014 'A Good Marriage,' reyalize pa Peter Askin epi bazé sou yon istwa kout de Stephen King. Menm jan King te di fim sa a te inspiré pa kaza BTK, Rawson avèk li ke li eksplwite trauman viktim yo ak fami yo—inkliz fami li. 'Li eksplwite dix viktim papa m ak fami yo,' li te di The Kansas City Star. 'Papa m pa valè tout liv sa yo, istwa nouvo yo, ak tout atansyon sa yo.' Rader te reponn ak regre: 'M desole fi m pa kontan. M ta gen menm reyaksyon an.' Li te repete ke fèm ak timoun yo pa konnen anyen sou krimen yo: 'Fami yo pa konnen anyen sou mes m nwa. M te kache sekret sa a jiska m te areste.'

article_content: On November 15, 2013, Ray Teret — a former DJ known as 'Ugly Ray' and one-time flatmate of the late Jimmy Savile — appeared in Manchester’s Minshull Street Crown Court facing 32 serious criminal charges relating to historical sexual abuse. The 72-year-old is accused of raping 15 girls, some as young as 11, between 1962 and 1996, with the majority of incidents occurring in the 1960s and 1970s. Additional charges include attempted rape, nine counts of indecent assault (three involving girls under 14), gross indecency with a child under 13, conspiracy to rape, and possession of extreme and illegal pornography. Dressed in a dark suit, overcoat, and purple scarf, Teret did not enter a plea during the brief hearing. He left court wearing gloves over his mouth and declined to speak to reporters. His trial is scheduled for October 2014, following a plea hearing in April. Two other men, William Harper, 65, and Alan Ledger, 62, were also charged with related offences against minors and appeared alongside him. All three were granted bail under strict conditions: no contact with any alleged victims. Greater Manchester Police confirmed that Teret’s case, though publicly associated with Savile due to their past relationship, is entirely separate from the national investigation into Savile’s crimes.

L'72 an, li akize de vyolete 15 pitit fi, kèk yo jwenn 11 an, nan ant 1962 ak 1996, ak plis nan peryòd 1960 ak 1970. Krimen lòt yo genyen: vyolet atèmpt, nev fòs seksyèl (twa sou yo nan pitit fi ki pi piti ke 14 an), indekans grav avèk yon timoun ki pi piti ke 13 an, konspiri pou vyolette, ak posesyon pornografi ekstrem ak imaj ilegal. Dresi avèk yon costim nwa, manteau, ak echarpe vyolet, Teret pa bay repons lan nan kòt ki te court la. Li te koule kòrt avèk gants sou bouk li ak pa reponn reportè yo. Jwenn li te planifye pou oktòb 2014, aprè yon asewo pou repons nan apri. De lòt moun, William Harper, 65 an, ak Alan Ledger, 62 an, te tou akize avèk krimen lòt yo konèk ak timoun yo ak te prezen avèk li. Tout tout trwa te pran konsa avèk kondisyon strik: pa kontakte okenn viktim akize. Pòl Manchester Grand te konfime ke kaza Teret, menm si li asosye avèk Savile a pa kòlèt yo, se yon kaza sepere de enfèstis nasyonal la sou krimen Savile a.

article_content: Pope Francis recently sparked controversy when he remarked that Catholics shouldn’t feel pressured to have children 'like rabbits' — a comment interpreted by many as dismissive of large families. During a press briefing aboard his return flight from the Philippines, he shared concern over a woman carrying her eighth child after seven cesarean sections. He questioned whether it was responsible to risk maternal health repeatedly, even if motivated by faith, noting that God provides tools for responsible family planning. His suggestion that 'three children is about right' for balanced parenthood drew sharp criticism from pro-life advocates and Catholic parents who felt their sacrifices were being minimized. In response, Vatican Archbishop Giovanni Becciu publicly apologized on the Pope’s behalf, insisting Francis never meant to undermine the dignity and joy found in large families. Francis, himself raised as the oldest of five siblings, later sought to soften the blow during a public audience in St. Peter’s Square, praising the beauty of families who welcome children as divine gifts. Former U.S. presidential hopeful Rick Santorum, a committed Catholic, admitted it’s sometimes hard to reconcile the Pope’s spontaneous remarks with traditional teachings, calling this instance particularly troubling. Yet, the Vatican’s clarification and the Pope’s subsequent affirmation suggest an effort to bridge misunderstanding — not to reject large families, but to encourage thoughtful, prayerful decision-making in parenthood.
translated_content: Papa Franse te fè yon kontroversi kòm li te di ke katolik yo pa dwe santi yo oblije fè timoun 'konsa konsa kòm lapou' — yon komantè ki te interpreté pa plis moun kòm yon diskredi sou fami ki gen plis timoun. Pendent yon konferans pres ki te fèt sou bato a lòt poul la, li te eksprime inquietid sou yon fanm ki te enceinte avèk timoun sa a huityèm li, aprè sept opérasyon sekè. Li te demann si se rezonab pou riské santè mè lan anpil, menm si sa a motivé pa fwa, epi li te fè konnen ke Bondye a ban nou mwayen pou plannifikasyon rezonab nan fami. Sajon li ke 'twa timoun se envite' pou parentèl rezonab te fèt yon reyaksyon fòt ak avokat pou vidi epi mè kote yo te santi yon diskredi sou tout sacrifice yo te fèt. Pou reyaji, arsevek Vatikan Giovanni Becciu te peche an non Papa Franse, ensisyan ke Franse pa te vle tounen yon diskredi sou dignite ak joie ki genyen nan fami ki gen plis timoun. Franse, ki te pi vye timoun nan yon fanmi ki te gen senk, te chache adouci yon ti jan domaj la pendent yon asanblè publik nan Place Saint-Pierre, ki te louvri bèlèf fami ki akwèt timoun yo kòm yon don divin. Ancien kandidat Repiblikèn pou prezidan Etazini Rick Santorum, yon katolik devot, te admè ke li parèt toujou difisil pou konprann komantè spontane Papa Franse avèk ensèmblaj tradisyonèl yo, epi li te jwenn kòmansman sa a patikilyèman trist. Menm jan, klaryifikasyon Vatikan ak afimasyon pa Papa Franse sipoze yon efò pou fè yon pont ant miskè — pa refize fami ki gen plis timoun, men pou enkouraje decizyon reflèksif ak pwayer nan parentèl.

article_content: Chris Simcox, co-founder of the Minuteman Civil Defense Corps and a former kindergarten teacher, was arrested on Wednesday on charges of child molestation. The 52-year-old is accused of having sexual contact with three girls under the age of 10 over several months. Phoenix police booked him into Maricopa County Jail on five charges: two counts of child molestation, two counts of sexual conduct with a minor, and one count of attempted molestation of a child. Detectives from the Family Investigations Bureau established probable cause for the arrests, according to Sergeant Tommy Thompson, a Phoenix police spokesperson. Simcox has denied the allegations to police, and it is unclear whether he has retained legal counsel. Simcox co-founded the Minuteman Civil Defense Corps in 2005 to draw attention to what he described as the government’s failure to secure the U.S.-Mexico border. The group, made up of volunteers including housewives, office workers, and veterans, patrolled southern Arizona until disbanding in 2010. Shortly before the group dissolved, Simcox resigned as its president and announced in April 2009 that he would challenge Senator John McCain in the Republican primary, though he later withdrew from the race. Simcox has a documented history of legal troubles. In 2010, his third ex-wife alleged he attempted to kill her on at least two occasions; a judge issued a protective order and ordered him to surrender his firearms. According to the Southern Poverty Law Center, his first wife accused him of attempting to molest their teenage daughter, and his second wife filed an emergency custody motion in 2005, citing concerns that Simcox had become increasingly dangerous after the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks. In April 2004, a federal judge sentenced Simcox to two years of probation for illegally carrying a firearm in Coronado National Memorial in January 2003, after he lied to a park ranger about possessing a weapon.
translated_content: Chris Simcox, kofondate Minuteman Civil Defense Corps ak yon ancien tanperè klas, te arete merkredi sou akuzasyon mòlèstis. Li, ki gen 52 an, ta akuzé te fè konnèksyon sekswè avèk twa pitit fi ki gen pi piti pase 10 an. Pòl Phoenix te mete li nan prizòn Maricopa County sou senk akuzasyon: de kòm mòlèstis, de kòm kondik sekswè avèk moin, ak yon kòm mòlèstis enplèt. Detektif Bureau Envestigasyon Famik te pwove kauz pòbav pou arest yo, selon Sèjan Tommy Thompson, espesyalis pòl Phoenix. Simcox te refize akuzasyon yo devan pòl, epi pa konnen si li gen yon avoka. Simcox te kofondate Minuteman Civil Defense Corps an 2005 pou mete an avant konsèn l sou defa etablisman frontyè a ak Meksiko. Grup la, ki te fèt ak volonte, fèm, travayè osefis ak vètèran, te patwol sou sòl Arizona tanke li te diskouraj an 2010. article_content: On a single day during the height of the Battle of Britain, Air Commodore Ronald Berry shot down three German fighters—one before breakfast, one after, and one in the evening. This extraordinary feat cemented his reputation as one of the Royal Air Force’s most celebrated aces of World War II. Over the course of the war, he was credited with destroying up to 30 enemy aircraft, 14 of which were officially confirmed. Berry, known by the nickname 'Ras,' was among the elite group of pilots dubbed 'The Few'—those whose courage helped prevent a Nazi invasion of Britain in the summer of 1940. His service extended beyond the Battle of Britain, including combat over France, North Africa, and later, Tunisia. In recognition of his valor, he received multiple decorations: the Distinguished Service Order (DSO), the Distinguished Flying Cross (DFC), the 1939–45 Star, the Air Crew Europe Star, the Africa Star, the Defence Medal, the War Medal, and the Air Efficiency Award. He was appointed Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in 1946 and Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) in 1965. His distinction was further honored when he was chosen to carry Winston Churchill’s coffin during the former prime minister’s state funeral in 1965—an honor reserved for only a handful of individuals. Born in Hull in 1917, Berry joined the RAF shortly after the war began. He flew with 603 Squadron, based initially in Montrose, Scotland, before being deployed to southern England during the critical months of the Battle of Britain. By August 1940, at just 23 years old, he was engaging in up to four dogfights per day. After the war, he commanded the Air Fighting Development Unit in Norfolk and retired to East Yorkshire with his wife, Nancy, and their daughter. He passed away in 2000 at age 83. His collection of medals, symbolizing a lifetime of service and sacrifice, is set to be auctioned in London on April 24. Experts estimate they will fetch approximately £120,000.

Berry, ki te jwenn non 'Ras', te yon nan plo tan 'The Few'—pilòt ki te pèmèt evite invazyon nazi yo sou Angleter nan lété 1940. Servis li te extendi anndan lòt teyèt, tankou Frans, Afrik Nò a, ak pi fòt Tyniz. Pou rekonèt valè li, li te resevwa plizyè distinksyon: Distinguished Service Order (DSO), Distinguished Flying Cross (DFC), 1939–45 Star, Air Crew Europe Star, Africa Star, Defence Medal, War Medal ak Air Efficiency Award. Li te nommé Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) an 1946 ak Commander of the Order of the British Empire (CBE) an 1965. Distinksyon li te pi fòt lè li te chwazi pou tènè kofè Winston Churchill nan enterèm li an 1965—yon honè ki rezève pou sèlman kèk moun. article_content: Four months after behind-the-scenes negotiations reshaped China’s top leadership, Xi Jinping is now preparing to officially begin his second decade as the nation’s leader. Alongside newly appointed Premier Li Keqiang, he inherits an economy that has lifted millions into prosperity but also left behind deep divides — a booming middle class alongside struggling migrant workers facing stagnant wages and rising costs. While the widening gap between rich and poor draws attention, experts warn that China’s most urgent struggles go even deeper. One critical issue is the massive gender imbalance caused by decades of the one-child policy and a persistent cultural preference for sons. Evolutionary biologist Rob Brooks highlights how millions of men — often called 'bare branches' — now face loneliness and social marginalization due to a shortage of women. He urges China to follow South Korea’s lead in banning sex-selective abortions and addressing gender-based neglect. Meanwhile, environmental degradation continues to threaten daily life. Author Geoff Hiscock describes polluted rivers, toxic farmland, choking air in cities like Beijing and Chongqing, and contaminated food supplies. Acid rain damages crops, diseases spread among livestock, and unsafe products still reach markets. These aren’t abstract risks — they’re everyday realities for hundreds of millions. Economist Li Gan points out that even though the government pledged to boost social spending by 2% over five years, that’s barely a start. Without a robust safety net covering healthcare, unemployment, and pensions, families will keep hoarding savings instead of spending — stalling the transition to a true consumer economy. The path forward demands bolder action, not incremental tweaks.

Ak nouvo premyè minis Li Keqiang, li te resevwa yon ekonomi ki te pòte milyonn moun anlè, men ki toujou lafòm divenn anpil — yon klas mwayen ki pwogrese ak moun ki travay yo ki pa gen pwogres salè ak kout ki monte. Yon defi enpotan se desbalans jendè konsiderab la ki rezilte nan plizyè ane politik sèl enfant ak preferans kiltirel pou timoun gason. Biyolojis evolisyonè Rob Brooks mete an lou kantite moun ki gen anpil moun ki genyen — souvan rele 'bran chwazi' — ki toujou jwenn yo anndan solitè ak marginalizasyon sosyal paske manke fanm. Li ap pousye Chini pou swiv lòt la Kòèyèn nan ban ane abòt jendè selèktif ak nijleksyon jendè. Manti, deteryorasyon envirònman an kontinye mete menm lavi a enas. Aotè Geoff Hiscock dekri rivyè polwe, tè fèt ak toutèl, lè ki anpil nan vil tankou Pekin ak Chongking, ak alimantasyon ki kontaminé. Plui sièk genyen koupe, maladi ap repand nan bèt, ak pwodwi ki pa sekiré yo toujou ap rive sou mache. Sa pa sèlman riske abstrè — sa se realite jounalis pou syèk milyon moun. Ekonomis Li Gan fè konnen ke menm si gouvenman an te jure pou aji depans sosyal 2% nan kòmansman kinkan an, sa se twò piti. San rete sosyal fòt pou santè, chomaj ak retra, fami yo ap kontinye mete sou ekonomi yo plis pase depans yo — ralanti transisyon an pou yon ekonomi konsomatè vre. Chemen ki devan an bezwen aksyon ki pi fò, pa modifikasyon ti ti.

article_content: Moscow, Russia (CNN) — Russian investigators combed through the charred remains of a nightclub in Perm on Saturday, detaining at least five people following a devastating fire that killed more than 100 and injured 130. The tragedy struck Friday night at the Lame Horse, a popular venue celebrating its eighth anniversary, when a performance artist ignited cold-flame pyrotechnics indoors. As the artist tossed the flaming maces skyward, the club’s wooden ceiling caught fire and quickly spread to the walls, trapping patrons and blocking exits. Many victims died from smoke inhalation or were crushed in the panicked scramble to escape. Authorities reported varying death tolls, with one source citing 109 fatalities. Dozens of the injured remain in critical condition, many on ventilators. Five individuals have been detained: two club co-owners, the manager, the art director, and the businessman who supplied the fireworks — now hospitalized with burns. A young female survivor recounted the horror: 'People were lying on the floor. Those still breathing were loaded into cars. Ambulances took only one person each. We screamed at doctors to take more.' Perm municipal official Igor Goncharov confirmed teams were assisting grieving families, providing updates on hospitalizations and identifications made by forensic teams. Outside the ruined club, mourners left flowers — a somber ritual echoing past tragedies in Moscow (2007) and Omsk (2008). The incident comes amid national shock over last week’s deadly train derailment near Moscow, which authorities labeled a terrorist attack. But Russian officials stressed this fire was an accident. 'The breach of safety protocols during pyrotechnic use caused the disaster,' said Investigative Committee spokesman Vladimir Markin. 'It was not terrorism.' In a televised address, President Dmitry Medvedev demanded the harshest penalties for those responsible and dispatched officials to Perm to coordinate medical aid and investigations. Prime Minister Vladimir Putin ordered two specialized burn-care planes flown from Moscow to assist survivors.

Trajedi sa a te pwochen vendredi nwit la nan Lame Horse, yon endiriksi popilè ki te fèt sou 8e anivèsè l, lè yon atri pèfòme ki te itilize pyroteknik fèy fèd. Lè atri a te lanse mase yo nan lavi, plafòn lan ki te fèt nan wòd te pran fèy epi te etenn rapidman sou pàt yo, ki te bloke tout eksit yo. Anpil viktimm yo te mouri pa inalasyon fèy yo oswa te travayé nan panik la pou fèt. Anotèt yo te bay chif varyab pou moun ki te mouri, yon sòs te di 109. Anpil viktimm yo toujou en kritik, anpil yo sou ventilatè. Kinkèt moun yo te arete: de kòpwoè, direktè, direktè atri, epi omèn ki te founi pyroteknik yo — ki toujou nan lapital avèk brulè yo. Trajedi sa a vin nan kontèks shok nasyonal la aprè derèyè krasman tren la nan Moscou, ki te klasifikè kòm yon atak teròris. Menm jan, ofisyèl Rus yo te mete aksan sou fèt sa a se yon aksidan. 'Breach nan protokòl sekirite lè itilizasyon pyroteknik yo te kauz ajidans la,' di Vladimir Markin, pòtvoz nan Komite Envestigasyon. 'Li pa te yon atak teròris.' Nan yon adres televizè, Prezidan Dmitry Medvedev te demann pèniti yo pi sever posib pou moun ki te responsab, epi li te envoye ofisyèl yo nan Pèm pou koordinè asestans medikal ak enfèstigasyon. Primè Minis Vladimir Putin te envoye de avyon spesyalize pou travayé moun ki te brule yo nan Moscou.

article_content: Originally, Prime Minister Tony Abbott had no intention of sending any Australian ministers to the climate talks in Lima, Peru. But Foreign Affairs Minister Julie Bishop wouldn’t accept that decision. As deputy leader of the Liberal Party, she advocated strongly for Australia’s presence at the global summit — and after a full cabinet meeting backed her, Abbott relented. The move came amid growing public frustration over the government’s handling of climate change, with a recent Fairfax poll revealing that 57% of Australians felt their leaders were doing far too little. Bishop, who will arrive in Lima on Tuesday, emphasized that having a minister at the table sends a powerful message: Australia is serious about securing a strong global climate deal ahead of the pivotal 2015 Paris negotiations. To appease the Prime Minister’s office, she agreed to bring Trade Minister Andrew Robb along — a symbolic 'chaperone.' The episode highlights deepening rifts within the government, especially after earlier attempts to sideline climate discussions at the Brisbane G20 backfired spectacularly. Reports suggest senior ministers had repeatedly warned Abbott’s team against suppressing climate dialogue, but their advice was ignored. Now, with Bishop heading to Lima, the cabinet appears determined to reset the tone — putting climate firmly back on the agenda.

Kòm viplèn Parti Libèral, li te defann ak pwopriyete prezen Ayiti nan sommet mondyal la — ak aprè yon mèt kabinèt ki te soutni li, Abbott te konsanti. Aksyon saa te pase nan kontèks fòs presyon publik sou gouvènman an sou klim, avèk yon sonaj Fairfax ki te montre ke 57% peyizan yo te sipoze dirijan yo fèt tro piti. Bishop, ki pral arive nan Lima mardi, te fèy konsa: avèk yon minisit nan tab la, ou di monn an ke Ayiti serièz sou konprann yon akò mondyal fort avan konferans Paris 2015 ki ta kapab chanje bagay. Kounye a, avèk Bishop ki al nan Lima, kabinèt la pati pou revizyon ton — mete klim sou lòt la ak tout kote.

article_content: In a deeply emotional verdict, a Nevada jury has sentenced James Michael Biela, 28, to death for the 2008 murder and sexual assault of Brianna Denison, a 19-year-old college student visiting friends in Reno. The crime, which sent shockwaves through the University of Nevada campus, was part of a series of violent attacks targeting young women. Biela was also found guilty of sexually assaulting two other students and kidnapping one of them. The breakthrough in the case came when police released images of distinctive underwear left near Denison’s body — a detail that a friend of Biela’s girlfriend recognized. That tip led investigators to Biela’s young son, whose DNA confirmed a match to evidence collected from the crime scenes. Forensic tests from the other victims’ rape kits further tied Biela to the assaults. Though his lawyers questioned the reliability of the DNA analysis and the credibility of eyewitness accounts, the jury was swayed by the overwhelming physical evidence and harrowing testimonies. Denison’s mother, Bridgette, pleaded with jurors to deliver justice without leniency, recalling her daughter’s final moments spent laughing with friends just hours before she vanished. The case, which sparked national headlines and thousands of tips, ended with Biela receiving the ultimate penalty under Nevada law.

Krim sa a, ki te fèt yon kou nan koumanse lèm nan Universite Nevada, te pati yon seri atak vyolet ki te viktimizè dlofèt yo. article_content: In a small Welsh town, Cenydd Nickels—a beloved dog warden and youth rugby coach—took matters into his own hands after discovering his 14-year-old son was buying cannabis. Devastated by the fact that his own mother had recently been brutally attacked for just six pounds to fund a drug habit, he decided to act. He set up a sting operation in a local park, expecting police backup. When no officers showed up, a physical altercation broke out. Nickels, determined to stop the dealer, placed him in the trunk of his car and drove to the nearest police station. The station was closed, so he called for help. Twenty minutes later, officers arrived—and arrested him for assault. Even though the dealer told police he didn’t want to press charges, Nickels was charged with kidnapping and causing actual bodily harm. Over the next five months, he appeared in court ten times, facing a £100,000 legal battle. Finally, prosecutors stunned everyone by dropping all charges without offering a reason. Neighbors in Ystradgynlais rallied behind him, calling his arrest a farce and a tragic misuse of public funds. On Facebook, Nickels shared a heartfelt message: his mother had needed stitches after the mugging, and he thanked the community for standing by him. 'We’ve won the battle,' he wrote, 'but the war against drugs isn’t over. We must protect our children. Report dealers. Support the police—but don’t wait for them to act.' The police declined to comment.

Anndan tout doulè a, mèt li te vye te vòlè ak vitlman pou sèlman 6 pònd pou achte drog, li te dekide aji. Li te fè yon operasyon enkòvè nan yon parèk, espere ase kòm pou polis yo ta ala. Menm lè konsommè a te di polis yo li pa vle fè plint, Nickels te akuzé de kidnapan ak fèt lèz laj. Pandan livèn senk mwa sa a, li te pase 10 fwa nan kòrt, epi te koute 100,000 pònd. Fènman, pwosekè yo te kase tout akuzasyon yo san pa balè yon eksplikasyon. Moun ki viv nan Ystradgynlais te ralèt sou li, di ke arèst la te yon blag ak yon gandèt pou fòs publik. article_content: Beijing (CNN) — For the second time in as many days, an unspecified threat led to the diversion of a Chinese airline flight, heightening public concern over aviation safety in one of the world’s fastest-growing air travel markets. On Thursday night, Shenzhen Airlines Flight ZH 9706 — traveling from Xiangyang in Hubei Province to Shenzhen — was diverted to Wuhan shortly after takeoff. The airline confirmed in a brief online statement that at 10:29 p.m. on August 30, 2012, the flight received threatening information. To ensure safety, the aircraft landed safely at Wuhan Tianhe International Airport at 11:22 p.m., and police were immediately called to investigate. The nature of the threat and the number of passengers aboard were not disclosed. The aircraft, an Airbus A320, typically carries around 150 passengers. Wuhan airport authorities later confirmed the diversion was triggered by an anonymous threatening call. State media reported that passengers spent the night in Wuhan and were scheduled to continue to Shenzhen on a replacement flight the following day. Meanwhile, on social media platforms like Sina Weibo, users expressed growing unease after two consecutive incidents and demanded greater transparency from airlines and officials. This follows a similar event on Wednesday, when Air China Flight CA 981, bound for New York, was forced to return to Beijing seven hours after departure. Air China and airport authorities stated that U.S. authorities had alerted China to a potential threat involving dangerous goods onboard. After a full security check, crew change, and re-screening of passengers and luggage, the flight departed again at 12:31 a.m. Thursday and arrived in New York at 12:38 a.m. the same day. The Boeing 747 carried up to 344 passengers. Passenger accounts on social media revealed confusion during both incidents. One traveler, using the handle Kejiwaijiao, noted the onboard flight map showed the plane turning back to Beijing — but crew initially claimed it was a display error. Another, Nataliebu, recalled being told only that the flight was experiencing severe turbulence. These inconsistent explanations fueled suspicion. These recent events come amid heightened awareness of aviation security in China. Just three months earlier, on June 29, 2012, six ethnic Uyghur men attempted to hijack a domestic flight in Xinjiang. They were subdued by passengers and crew, and the plane returned safely to its origin. Despite stringent security at Beijing Capital International Airport — the world’s second-busiest hub, serving over 78 million passengers in 2011 — repeated near-misses have raised questions about preparedness and communication protocols.

Inisyan sa yo vin anndan yon kaden nan konskenn manm aviyasyon an nan Chine. Twa mwa anvan, 29 jen 2012, sis moun etnik Uyghur te eseye pran kontwol yon vòl lokal nan provins Xinjiang. article_content: On a quiet Saturday evening in Radcliffe, Greater Manchester, 16-year-old Callum Hilton was crossing Stand Lane with three friends and his cousin when a passing car struck him with devastating force. Thrown nearly 20 feet through the air, Callum suffered severe head trauma. Despite immediate efforts by bystanders—including a neighbor who was a nurse—and emergency responders, he died hours later in the hospital, surrounded by his family. The driver did not stop. Police quickly launched a hit-and-run investigation, leading to the arrest of a 32-year-old man in the Radcliffe area. However, authorities later confirmed the vehicle seized was not the one involved—another silver Peugeot 206 remains the focus. Callum’s mother, Tricia Hilton, shared her anguish on Facebook: 'I can’t sleep… because when I wake up, it’s all real again—holding my son as he passed.' His grandfather, Graham Hilton, echoed the family’s devastation, asking for privacy as they mourned. Residents say Stand Lane has long been dangerous. One witness recalled seeing a dog killed nearby just minutes before the crash, and another reported a car hit just days earlier. Multiple 30mph signs line the steep, busy street, yet speeding remains common. Hundreds of people left flowers, teddy bears, and handwritten notes reading '#Callum xxx' at the crash site. Online, thousands posted tributes, calling for justice and safer roads. GMP continues to urge anyone with information—especially about the elusive silver Peugeot—to come forward.

Li te lanmò pou 20 pye, epi li te gen grav yo. Malgre aksyon rapid nan moun ki te la—tankou yon voisin ki se yon asistans—li te mouri kèk or apre nan ospital, avèk fanmi li sou lavi yo. Pilòt lan pa sipoze. Pwolès la te demare yon envestigasyon pou fèt ak fèt ak deplasman, epi yo te arete yon gason 32 an nan zòn Radcliffe. Men, autorite yo te konfime ke machin ki te pran an pa se a—yon lòt Peugeot 206 argante pa tèt envestigasyon an. Mè Callum, Tricia Hilton, te partaj doulè li sou Facebook: 'M pa ka dòmi… paske lè m reve, tout sa a vin reyel—m t'ap tenn fi mwen lè li te mouri.' Grandpè Callum, Graham Hilton, te renmen doulè fanmi a, epi te demann pou yo pèmèt yo plede. Abitan yo di ke Sit Lane te toujou dange. Yon témoin te raple ke yon chien te mouri nan yon distans ki fè 100 pye pi wo lè yon minit avan fèt la, epi yon lòt te raple ke yon machin te frap yon moun se yon jou anvan. Miltip lekèl 30mph yo lèn lavi yo, men vites lan toujou kontinye. Sèlèm moun te lèye flè, jouj, ak kard ki te ekri '#Callum xxx' sou lòt kote fèt la. Sou rezo sosyal, milyèn moun te mete mesaj kondolen, mande jisis ak rwayèl pi sekir. GMP kontinye rele tout moun ki gen enfòmasyon—espesyalman sou Peugeot 206 argante ki pa tèt la—pou yo kontakte yo.

article_content: Weston-super-Mare, a charming seaside town known for its Grand Pier, promenade, and beaches, has become an unlikely hotspot for divorce. Last year, 2,447 divorce petitions were filed in the town — home to just 80,000 residents — making it the second-highest rate in the UK outside London. That’s 7.5% of all adults over 16. While Birmingham recorded the most petitions overall (2,799), its population exceeds 1.1 million — more than twelve times larger. Other high-ranking areas included Leicester (1,831 petitions), Romford (1,783), and Coventry (1,766). The Ministry of Justice (MoJ) released these figures as part of a push to encourage separating couples to use publicly funded mediation instead of contentious court battles. Although it did not explain why Weston-super-Mare’s divorce rate is so high, experts suggest economic pressures may play a role. The town suffered a major blow in 2008 when its iconic Grand Pier burned down; though rebuilt at great cost, tourism took another hit during last year’s wettest summer on record, with some local businesses reporting revenue drops of up to 60%. In response, the MoJ is investing £25 million in mediation services this year. New laws now require couples seeking court orders on child custody or finances to first attend a mandatory mediation assessment. Family Justice Minister Lord McNally emphasized that mediation offers a simpler, cheaper, and more constructive path to resolution. 'We know that when working out how to split assets and arrange time with the children, mediation leads to better outcomes for everyone,' he said. Mediation involves trained, neutral third parties helping couples reach agreements without going to court.
translated_content: Weston-super-Mare, yon vila maritim ki konn pou Grand Pier, promenade ak plaj yo, te fèt yon kantèn pou divòsman. Menm si Birmingham te gen plis petyisyon (2,799), popilasyon li depase 1.1 milyon — plis pase douz fwa plis. Autre zòn ki te anndan top yo te Leicester (1,831 petyisyon), Romford (1,783), ak Coventry (1,766). Ministèri Jistis (MoJ) te publiye chif sa yo pou pousiye koupl ki separe yo pou itilize mediasyon finansye pa etat lan pou evite batay kout kout. Menm si li pa ekspike poukisa tasa divòsman nan Weston-super-Mare ni tou pre, eksperyen yo sipoze presyon ekonomik yo ka jwe yon ròl. Vil la te pèdi yon gwo koup an 2008 lè Grand Pier li te koupe; menm si li te rekonstwi avèk yon kout fò, tirisim te genyen yon lòt koup pandan ete ki pi pli plie nan ane dènye, ak kèk entreprenè lokal ki te rapòte pèt revni 60%.  Pou reyaji, MoJ ap investi 25 milyon funn nan mediasyon sa a ane sa a. article_content: On an Afghan battlefield in Helmand Province, Lance Corporal Matthew Wilson, 21, risked his life to save a wounded comrade under fire from a Taliban sniper. During a reconnaissance mission near Nahr-e Saraj, his unit was ambushed, and a fellow soldier was shot in the leg. Without hesitation, Wilson ran across open ground — deliberately drawing sniper fire to create an opening for rescue. A bullet struck his helmet, knocking him unconscious. His comrades feared the worst — until he rose moments later, dazed but alive, sprinted 50 yards, and returned fire. The bullet had deflected off his helmet, sparing his life but leaving him with a severe headache. His bravery allowed a medevac helicopter to land and evacuate the injured soldier. For this act of exceptional courage, Wilson was awarded the Military Cross, the United Kingdom’s second-highest decoration for gallantry, during an investiture at Buckingham Palace. Now based in Northern Ireland, Wilson was one of three soldiers from the 2nd Battalion The Rifles honored that day. He described the moment as routine: 'Stuff like this happens every day,' he told the Telegraph. 'I was just lucky to be recognized — but this award belongs to everyone.'
translated_content: Sur yon champ de bataill nan Afganistan, nan Helmand, Lance Corporal Matthew Wilson, 21 an, te mete lavi li an pèl pou sauve yon kòmèd ki te blessé pa yon tirè tan taliban. Pandan yon misyon rekonèsman nan Nahr-e Saraj, unité li te vini sou yon embus, ak yon lòt soldat te poulé nan jami. Senkòd, Wilson te kouri sou tè ouvè — fè yon tirè tan sipoze pou fè yon oto pou evakwasyon. Yon boul la te frapé kalot li, fè li pèdi konskisans li. Kòmèd yo te peche l te mouri — men li te leve pito, epi, moun yo te gen lavi, li te kouri 50 yard ak li te kòmanse reponn. Pou aksyon sa a ki te eksep syonèl, Wilson te resevwa Military Cross, dezyèm plis grand distinksyon britanik pou valè, pandan yon seremoni nan Buckingham Palace. Ora, li rezide nan Irlande Nò, Wilson te yon nan twa soldat nan 2nd Battalion The Rifles ki te rekonèt jodi a. Li te dekri moman sa a kòm yon bagay ki fèt chak jou: 'Bagay sa yo fèt chak jou,' li te di Telegraph. 'Mwen te sèlman fortin pou rekonèt — men distinksyon sa a poutou pou tout moun.'

article_content: Ather Energy, the electric two-wheeler manufacturer, is planning to launch a new family-oriented scooter in early 2024. CEO Tarun Mehta confirmed that the upcoming model will be larger than the current 450 series, offering greater space and comfort. He described it as an affordable entry-level option, expanding the company’s product portfolio. Alongside the new scooter, the existing 450 series — including the 450S and 450X — will receive performance updates in early 2024. The updates will retain the clean, minimalist design while enhancing performance and features. Mehta stated that the refreshed 450 range will deliver the 'pinnacle of refined performance' with best-in-class technology, though he acknowledged the upgrades will come at a premium price. In a social media post, Mehta wrote: 'This new iteration is set to be the absolute pinnacle of refined performance. It will have best-in-class features that will redefine your riding experience. We’re launching in early 2024, and yes, it comes with a premium price tag, but trust me, it's worth every bit.' Currently, the Ather 450 lineup includes two trims: the 450S and the 450X. The 450X features a larger 3.7 kWh battery pack and offers a claimed range of 150 km per charge. Both models have a top speed of 90 km/h. Pricing starts at ₹1.30 lakh for the 450S and ₹1.38 lakh for the 450X (ex-showroom). With these launches, Ather Energy aims to reinforce its position as a leader in innovative, high-performance electric mobility solutions.

Li te dekri li kòm yon opsyon abòdab pou entèn konsomatè, pou ekspande portfolio kompani a. Apre nouvo skòtè a, seri 450 kounya a — ki gen 450S ak 450X — pral resevwa amelyorasyon peyòman an jenveye 2024. Amelyorasyon yo pral konsève konsepsyon net, minimalis la tout enplasye pèfòmans ak fonksyonnalite yo. Mehta te deklare ke seri 450 mizye a pral pòte 'pinnacle de pèfòmans rafiné' ak teknoloji ki pi bon nan klas la, men li te admi ke amelyorasyon yo pral koute pi chè. Nan yon mesaj sou rezo sosyal, Mehta te ekri: 'Nouvo itirasyon sa a pral ete pinnacle absoli de pèfòmans rafiné. Li pral gen fonksyon ki pi bon nan klas la ki pral redefine eksperyans ou nan konduis. Nou ap lansman an jenveye 2024, epi wi, li gen yon pri premyèm, men konfyan mwen, li vale tout dola yo.' Kounya a, liney 450 Ather gen de nivo: 450S ak 450X. 450X gen yon bateri 3.7 kWh ki pi enen ak yon plasman ki pral 150 km avèk yon fèl. De modèl yo gen yon vitès maksimòm 90 km/h. Prix yo kòmanse a ₹1.30 lakh pou 450S ak ₹1.38 lakh pou 450X (ex-showroom). Avec lansman sa yo, Ather Energy vle reforse pozisyon li kòm yon lider nan mobilite elektrik inovatè ak pèfòman elève.

article_content: Former Fulham captain Danny Murphy says Felix Magath’s only contribution to English football is a masterclass in how not to run a club. Magath was replaced as Fulham’s manager by Kit Symons last week after a disastrous seven-month tenure, during which the team was relegated from the Premier League and then sank to the bottom of the Championship with just one point from seven games. The 61-year-old German has defended his reign, telling the German news agency DPA: 'I am convinced that English football has something to learn from German qualities.' But Murphy responded sharply to the Press Association Sport: 'All he has to offer is showing others how not to do it.' Magath’s methods have drawn fierce criticism from former players, notably ex-captain Brede Hangeland, who claimed Magath advised him to treat a leg injury by applying quark — a soft, unripened dairy product common in Germany — to the affected area. Murphy, who played alongside Hangeland for nearly five years, revealed an even stranger detail: 'I texted Brede to ask if it was true,' he said. 'He told me it was — and that the quark had to be soaked in alcohol. He was also told to call his mother because speaking to someone who loves him would help the treatment work.' Magath later clarified regarding the Hangeland reports: 'I merely suggested it could be worth trying the old wives’ tale of applying quark to the injured area. I would never tell a doctor what to do.' 'It's sad that a club as stable as Fulham is now in such turmoil,' Murphy added. 'It was a mistake to keep him in charge after relegation. The players I spoke to were desperate to leave because of him.' Murphy has expressed interest in the Fulham managerial role but has not formally applied and has had no contact with the club’s hierarchy. Meanwhile, Symons took charge for Saturday’s 1-0 loss to Blackburn and will manage Tuesday’s Capital One Cup third-round tie against Doncaster. 'Kit’s a very good coach,' Murphy said. 'He took over on Saturday, and although they lost, there were more smiles around the place. It’s important they get a win against Doncaster to build some confidence.'
translated_content: Kapiten ansiyèn Fulham Danny Murphy di Felix Magath gen yon sèl kontribisyon pou fotbòl Angle: yon lekons sou kisa pa fèt pou ranpli yon kloub. Magath te deplase kòm entrenè Fulham pa Kit Symons la dènye sezan, aprè yon peyizaj sèvèn mwa ki te pèmèt ekipaj la rebete nan Premier League epi apre sa, yo te pèdi nan pati pi ba Championship avèk sèlman yon pwen nan sèvèt jwenn. Aji 61 an, almayèn sa a te deklare pou agans pres Almayen DPA: 'Mwen konvini ke fotbòl Angle gen konsa pou apann nan kalite Almayèn.' Men, Murphy te reponn ak vireman pou Press Association Sport: 'Li gen konsa pou ofri se montre lòt moun kisa pa fèt.' Metòd Magath te fèt ak vyan nan anndan anseyèn jwèt, espesyalman kapiten an anpil Brede Hangeland, ki te deklare ke Magath te konseye li pou treti yon leziyon nan jambe avèk yon pwojèt kwek — yon prodwi lakté, senp, ki poul nan Almayen — sou zòn leziyon an. Murphy, ki te jwe ak Hangeland pandan preske sink ane, te revele yon detay ki pi etranj: 'Mwen te envwaye Brede pou konnen si sa te vre,' li te di. 'Li te reponn mwen se vre — epi ke kwek la te dwe imèj nan alkol. Li te tou konseye li pou rele manman li paske pale avèk yon moun ki renmen li ta ajanse tretman an.' Magath te korekte pou rapòt Hangeland: 'Mwen sèlman te suggere ke sa ka valè poul alèz la aplikasyon kwek sou zòn leziyon an. Mwen pa t'ap konseye yon mezin kisa fèt.' 'Mwen tris ke yon kloub tankou Fulham ki te stab la menm nan yon kris total,' Murphy te ajoute. 'Sa te yon fòt pou konsève li apre rebet. Jwèt yo ki te pale avèk mwen te desire kite li paske li.' Murphy te exprime intres pou pozisyon entrenè Fulham, men li pa te depozit yon aplikasyon ofisyèl epi li pa te gen okenn kontak avèk dirijans kloub lan. Moun sa a, Symons te pran kontrolye pou defa 1-0 kontra Blackburn epi li ta pral dirije match koup Capital One kontra Doncaster mardi swa. 'Kit se yon bon entrenè,' Murphy te di. 'Li te pran kontrolye samedi, epi menm si yo te pèdi, yo te plis souri. Li enpòtan yo vin gagnen kontra Doncaster pou kreye yon konsidan.'

article_content: Michael Grimm, a Republican congressman from New York who has served since 2011, is set to plead guilty in federal court to a single charge of aiding in the preparation of a false tax return. The charge stems from his involvement with Healthalicious, a Manhattan health food restaurant in which he held a 45% stake. Prosecutors allege that between 2008 and 2010, Grimm helped conceal over $1 million in revenue by maintaining fake payroll records, avoiding payroll and income taxes, and underpaying workers—including undocumented immigrants—below minimum wage. Originally facing 20 federal counts, Grimm agreed to a plea deal to avoid a January trial that would have exposed these alleged schemes in detail. Although the felony carries a maximum sentence of three years, sources close to his legal team say he does not anticipate serving time behind bars. Grimm, a former FBI agent and one of the few Republicans representing a heavily Democratic district, surprisingly won re-election in November 2014 by a wide margin, even as public scrutiny intensified. His case gained national attention earlier in 2014 after a video surfaced showing him threatening a NY1 journalist, telling him he would ‘throw you off this f***ing balcony’ after being asked about campaign finance probes. Grimm later apologized for the outburst. His longtime partner, Diana Durand, previously pleaded guilty to orchestrating illegal campaign donations through straw donors—a tactic also used by conservative filmmaker Dinesh D'Souza. With his plea hearing scheduled for Tuesday in Brooklyn, Grimm may seek to remain in office during probation, but House Republicans hold the power to expel him. The House Ethics Committee has deferred action until the judicial process concludes. No public statements have been issued by Grimm’s attorneys or federal prosecutors ahead of the hearing.

Akuzasyon fede a ka amene l nan tout 3 an an prizon, men yon moun ki konnen nègòsyasyon an di DailyMail.com lundi ke kongresis lan pa sipoze ale prizon. Grimm se yon eks-agent FBI ak yon rara Repiblikèn nan vila ki dominé pa Demokrat yo. Fèt li a pral depann jij fede Pamela Chen, menm si li te resevwa 20 akuzasyon fede yo, epi li te kontinye travay pou konstitiyan yo avèk yon caution $400,000 ki te akordé an printemps. LI TE KOUNYE APO LÈKAP ? Repiblikèn New York Michael Grimm pral plwe genpren maridi pou yon akuzasyon fiskal fede. Grimm te konservé inosans li tout sezon kampany 2014, men li pral admet yon krim kounye a aprè li te re-ekli. Loretta Lynch, avoka fede ki te an fonksyon nan Brooklyn, N.Y., te mete akuzasyon sa a sou Grimm lane sa a, fè li premyè lòd fede ki te akize kriminèlman depi 2008. Lynch te vin chwa Prezidan Barack Obama pou remplace Eric Holder kòm avoka jeneral fede. Pa plwe genpren pou yon sèl akuzasyon fiskal, li evite yon trial ki te planifi pou janvye. Jury a te ta dwe entandi detay sou projè a ki te pèmèt li kache plis pase $1 milyon nan vendès ak salè restoran an pou evite pajman fiskal ant 2008 ak 2010. Li tou te akize dwe emba travayè ki te illegal yo. Otorite yo alèk la ke Grimm te gen de list travayè, yon ki te fiktif, pou li evite pajman fiskal, pajman salè ak kòst konsèy travayè. Lè kèk travayè yo te fè yon aksyon pou salè yo, Grimm te te wòdè sou jure. Akizatè yo klame ke li te tèmògnè fòlman ke li pa janm peye travayè restoran an an espes. Janvye, Grimm te vin yon non konnen lè yon jonalis New York te vwaye li nan videyo a te amenase li pou l pouse li yo bale yo nan balkon kongres fede a pou li te posé yon kesyon difisil sou yon envestigasyon fede ki te fèt sou finansman kampany li an 2010. Grimm te peye yon caution $400,000 pou li rete lib toutotan akuzasyon fiskal yo te pende sou li nan yon kaz ki te anlè payman espes ilegal yo fèt pou travayè illegal yo nan restoran an pou evite pajman fiskal. Grimm te fèt fèt lè jonalis NY1 Michael Scotto te pase lòt tem yo aprè discou Prezidan Obama sou etat de l'union 28 janvye. Kongresis lan te alé lòt bò kameran an soudain lè tem lan te monte, di li pa vle pale 'sou lòt tem.' Michael Scotto, jonalis videyo pou stasyon NY1, te resevwa amenas de Grimm janvye a nan Kapisol Fede. Grimm 'pa vle pale sou kèk akuzasyon yo sou finansman kampany li', di Scotto, konsa lòt segman televizyon an. Men kameran an te kontinye enkri lè kongresis lan te kriye. 'Fè m konprann ou,' li di. 'Si ou fè sa ankò pou m, m'ap pouse ou de lòt bale f***ing sa a.' 'Pourkisa? Se yon kesyon valid,' respond Scotto. 'Pa, pa, ou pa gen asèn, ou pa gen asèn,' Grimm te reponn. 'M'ap kase ou an dènye. Tankou yon timoun.' Grimm te demann pardon lendemain. Jaden li longtan, Diana Durand, te plwe genpren septanm pou transmete lajan an ilegal pou kampany li pa paye 'donatè fiktif' pou fè donasyon yo. Nan kèk ka, li te rembourse yo apre. Schèm sa a kache ki te sòti lajan an epi pèmèt Grimm kapab profite pi fòk lajan kampany Durand an pase ley la pèmèt. Filmmaker konservatè Dinesh D'Souza te plwe genpren mwa me a pou menm krim sa a. Li te rembourse zanmi yo pou donasyon yo pou kampany Wendy Long ki te echwe nan sena. article_content: The mysterious disappearance of Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 has left experts and the public alike searching for answers — but definitive information remains elusive. Even promising leads, such as Chinese satellite images suggesting debris, have been disproven by Malaysian authorities, who found no trace after thorough searches. Amid the flood of speculation, some logical explanations still hold weight. One common focus — the aircraft’s transponders — may be misleading. The Boeing 777 carries two independent transponders. If one failed, the crew would immediately switch to the other. A simultaneous failure is highly improbable unless there was a catastrophic electrical systems malfunction. Another possibility: the plane may have flown beyond radar coverage, either by navigational error or as part of standard nonradar procedures used over oceans. On routes like the North Atlantic tracks, pilots report their positions via automated systems to ground services like AIRINC. These reports allow computers to track aircraft without real-time radar. If Flight 370 deviated from its path during such a phase, no alert would trigger until the next scheduled position report. The 777 is one of the most technologically advanced commercial aircraft ever built. Its onboard systems continuously transmit critical data — including altitude, speed, and heading — directly to the airline for operational and maintenance purposes. A total loss of this data stream suggests a severe, possibly catastrophic, failure. While it's remotely possible the airline’s receiving system malfunctioned, such an explanation is unlikely without supporting evidence. In the event of a serious mechanical issue, pilots are trained to prioritize flying the aircraft, then navigating, then communicating — 'aviate, navigate, communicate.' It’s conceivable that the crew was overwhelmed by an emergency and unable to send a distress call before losing control. One speculative but plausible theory involves a fuel tank explosion. Though the center tank of a 777 is typically kept nearly empty during long flights, residual vapors could ignite due to an electrical fault in a fuel pump — a scenario linked to the 1996 TWA Flight 800 disaster. Boeing issued safety recommendations following that incident, and most airlines implemented them. Whether Malaysia Airlines complied remains unclear. With the satellite lead proven false, some suggest shifting search efforts to land areas — perhaps indicating a deliberate course change. But regardless of the cause, debris will eventually be found. Aviation accidents rarely stem from a single factor; they are almost always the result of a chain of events. The investigation process may be slow and frustrating, but it is methodical. With the NTSB’s involvement, the world can expect a rigorous, evidence-based conclusion. Aircraft do not vanish without a trace — and the truth, however long it takes, will emerge.
translated_content: Disparisyon misterye a Flight 370 Malaysia Airlines te lajé ekspèt ak moun anndan tout monn — men enfòmasyon defenitif pa gen. Meme pwojekt ki te sanse fèt, tankou imaj satelit chine yo ki te sugere debriz yo, te refize pa autorite malaysyen yo, ki pa jwenn okenn trace aprè rechèch detay yo. Anndan onfòmasyon ki te fèt, kèk eksplikasyon lòjik toujou rete valab. Yon sèl fokis sou transpondè yo a kapab pi fò. Avyon Boeing 777 gen de transpondè endepandan. Si yon sèl te panse, ekipaj yo ta pral chaje lòt la tout de sekond. Yon panisman similtane se trè enprobab, sa ouvri posibilite yon panisman elektrik grav. Yon lòt posiblite: avyon an te ka ala depi de rayon radar, oswa pa fèt nan kadr prosedi non-radar ki itilize sou osean. Sou itinèr yo konsa tankou Trak Atlantik Nò, pilòt yo rapòte pozisyon yo atravè sistèm otomatik pou servis sol yo konsa AIRINC. Sistèm sa yo pèmèt kalkilatè yo suivi avyon yo sans radar enstantane. Si Flight 370 te deplase de itinèr li a nan faza sa a, pa gen okenn alèt ki ta debouche tan ke yo ta vini nan punk rapòt ki te dekide. 777 se yon nan avyon komersyal ki pi avanse teknolojikman ki te konstrwi. Sistèm yo a transmèt enfòmasyon kritik yo — tankou altitid, vitès, ak direksyon — direkman pou ayirin yo pou operasyon ak mantennans. Pèd total sa a enfòme yon panisman grav, oswa katasrofik. Menm si posib ke sistèm resepsyon ayirin an te panse, sa a trè enprobab san evidans. Anndan yon sitiyasyon mekanik grav, pilòt yo ta asepté priorite: pilotaj, navigasyon, apel — 'aviate, navigate, communicate.' Se posib ke ekipaj la te soukòt pa gen tan pou fè yon mesaj de distres avan pèdi kontwol avyon an. Yon teori spikulatif men plasib se yon eksplòsyon tank fiyè. Tank sentral 777 la te toujou preske vide nan vol long, men vapè rezidil yo te ka ignis pa yon defekt elektrik nan pompe fiyè. Sitiyasyon sa a te lye ak eksplòsyon TWA Flight 800 nan 1996. Boeing te envite modifikasyon sekirite aprè sa, ak plis ayirin yo te aplike yo. Pa konnen si Malaysia Airlines te aplike yo. Apre pwojekt satelit la te refize, kèk moun suggere rechèch lan dwe fèt sou teren — konsa montre ke ekipaj la te dekide al kote lòt. Men, pa importe kòz la, debriz yo ta jwenn. Akidantan avyon pa janm rezilte nan yon sèl fakto; yo toujou rezilte nan yon kaden de evenman. Pwosesis investigasyon an kapab lent ak fasil, men li sistematik. Apre NTSB la, monn ka aminn yon konklizyon rigouz ak baz evidans. Avyon yo pa disparèt sans trace — ak verite a, menm si li ta dwe pataje long, li ta vini.

article_content: On June 24, 2013, a Thomas Cook Airlines Airbus A330 bound for the Dominican Republic suffered a sudden right engine failure while taxiing at Manchester Airport. The aircraft, carrying 325 passengers, had not yet taken off when the engine erupted in flames and began emitting thick smoke. The pilot immediately reacted, stabilizing the plane and bringing it to a safe stop. Emergency crews, including three fire engines, rushed to the scene as a precaution. Fortunately, no one was injured. Thomas Cook confirmed that the situation was contained and that all passengers were safely rebooked onto another aircraft later that same afternoon. The airline thanked travelers for their patience during the unexpected delay.

Avyon an, ki te pòte 325 passaj, pa te ankò levé lè motè dwat lan te eksploze ak te kòmanse pwodui yon nèg lajè. Pilòt lan te reyaji tout dekò, tenn avyon an稳, ak ramen li nan yon endèm sèk. Ekwipaj d'ensidans, tankou twa kamyon piyè, te ale sou sitiyasyon an kòm yon preokupasyon. Malgre sa, pa gen moun ki te blesé. Thomas Cook te konfime ke sitiyasyon an te kontwòlè ak tou le passaj yo te reeboke sou yon lòt avyon anmwen menm jou a. Kompani a te remerasyon voyage yo pou patyans lan pandan reta a.

article_content: By Katy Winter. The first-ever transgender beauty pageant was held in Turkey, showcasing colorful outfits, dramatic makeup, and immense courage. Simply staging the event was a bold act: although homosexuality is legal in Turkey, lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) individuals face persistent legal discrimination and societal hostility. The pageant formed part of a week-long LGBT celebration taking place against a backdrop of violence against transgender people. Among the 13 contestants, Anna Narin won 'Best Dressed,' while Yanki Bayramoglu was crowned overall winner. Backstage, contestants supported one another with hair styling, makeup, and costume adjustments — a powerful display of solidarity. Photographer Sedat Suna captured both the intimate moments behind the scenes and the energetic performances on stage. Before a crowd of around 500, a jury of eight transgender individuals awarded points to the competitors, who first appeared in bikinis and later in formal gowns. Yanki Bayramoglu emerged victorious, celebrating her win with joy. According to LGBT Turkey, 70 transgender people have been killed in the country since 2002. A 2011 Amnesty International report found that hate crimes — including violent attacks and murders targeting LGBT people — are common but rarely investigated by authorities. Despite this, the contestants chose to shine a light on their lives through art, beauty, and defiance.
translated_content: Pa Katy Winter. Premye fèt bèlès transpèson ki te fèt an Tirkí, ki te montre kòs ti moun, makijaj ki fèy ak enmen kouraj. Fèt sa a te yon aktyon enterèn: menm si homosekswalite a legal an Tirkí, moun LGBTT ki gen kontinyen diskriminasyon jwèt ak hostilité sosiyal. Fèt sa a te pati dè yon semèn fèt LGBTT ki te fèt nan yon kontekst vyolen anba konsèn tranpèson. Anant 13 kontesan, Anna Narin te gagnye 'Pi Bònn Kòs', pandan Yanki Bayramoglu te kòrònne genèral. Arrière-skèn, kontesan yo te asesté yo mem pou peyn, makijaj ak rangman kòs yo — yon afèm fòs solidarite. Fotojraf Sedat Suna te kapte moman intèm ak performans yo sou skèn. Devan yon foule ki te pwochen 500 moun, yon juri ki te konpoze de 8 moun transpèson te atribi pwen yo sou 13 kontesan ki te parèt d'abòd nan bikini yo, epi apre nan roba fòmèl yo. Yanki Bayramoglu te genyen, ak li te fèt fèy pou vitwa li. Anplis LGBT Turkey, 70 moun transpèson te mouri an Tirkí depi 2002. Rapò Amnesty International 2011 te montre ke krimen hait — tankou atak vyolen ak meyd ki vize moun LGBTT — se frèk, men pa preske janm envesti pa otorite yo. Malgre sa, kontesan yo te chwazi mete lumanèt sou liv yo atravè art, bèlè, ak rezistans.

article_content: When most of us make a spelling mistake at work, a quick press of the delete key fixes it. But that option wasn’t available to road workers in Carlisle, who mistakenly painted 'KEEP CEEAR' near the Civic Centre — a blunder swiftly noticed and shared by drivers. Contractors corrected the error at no cost, and Cumbria County Council issued a public apology. Councillor Willie Whalen remarked, 'Anyone can make a mistake. It’s clearly genuine — it just shows how hard the team is working.' Cyril Weber, chair of the Carlisle Local Committee, added, 'It’s a basic human error. Most people still understand what it means.' Meanwhile, in York, Northern Gas workers inadvertently created a traffic confusion by re-laying road bricks with double yellow lines in random order — leaving a jumbled pattern resembling the classic video game Tetris. Until the markings were corrected yesterday, drivers were left uncertain about parking rules. The misaligned lines sparked public commentary: one passerby likened them to 'a trail of scrambled egg,' while another joked, 'They’d better hurry — this isn’t a wide road, and if drivers start testing the limits, we could have chaos.' Despite the mess, no parking tickets were issued over the weekend. The City of York Council confirmed Northern Gas completed the broader gas main upgrade project four and a half weeks ahead of schedule. The company acknowledged the road markings were misplaced during brick reinstallation and were removed mechanically before repainting the correct double yellow lines to avoid weekend disruption. Tetris, the iconic puzzle game created by Russian programmer Alexey Pajitnov in 1984, became a cultural touchstone for the incident. Its name derives from 'tetramino' — a shape made of four connected squares — and 'tennis,' Pajitnov’s favorite sport. The game’s famous theme song is based on the 19th-century Russian folk tune 'Korobeiniki,' arranged by Hirokazu Tanaka. The phenomenon known as the 'Tetris Effect' — where repetitive tasks begin to influence thought patterns — was humorously invoked by onlookers.
translated_content: Lè moun yo fè yon faiti d’epelaj nan travay yo, yon sèl fèt sou bouton delete a kapab rezoud li. Menm opsyon sa a pa te disponib pou travayè yo nan Carlisle ki te ekri 'KEEP CEEAR' nan envirònman Sentè Civil — yon fòt ki te wè ak kouraj pa machann yo. Kontraktè yo te kore fòt la san koze, ak Konsil Kòmbri yo te peche yon aploji piblik. Konsèyè Willie Whalen te di, 'Chak moun ka fè yon fòt. Li klè ke se yon fòt anndan, li montre kòman timoun yo travay fòt.' Cyril Weber, prezidan Kominite Lokal Carlisle, te ajoute, 'Se yon fòt nati. Moun plis yo konnen sa yo vle di, malgre epelaj la.' Mwenmàn, nan York, travayè yo nan Northern Gas te fè yon konfizyon trafik enkonsekan yo te remete brik yo avèk linyen jòn doubl yo nan ordonnans alewato — te lajere yon motif ki rezime jwenn videojwèn klasisik Tetris. Lè mark yo te kore yestè, machann yo te gen twoub pou konprann limit parke a. Mark yo te pouse reaksyon piblik: yon pase a te kompare yo ak 'yon kòd d’oeuf melangé,' menm jan yon lòt te jwe, 'Yo dwe vit — sa pa yon rous kote, esi de machann yo pran avantaž la, sa ka fè yon kras trafik.' Malgre tout sa, pa gen anyen ki te fèt sou wèkènd lan. Konsil Vila York te konfirme ke Northern Gas te fini projè a de katè ak demi seken devan ekipman. Kompani a te admi ke mark yo te mal plaçe pandan remet brik yo, epi yo te retire yo mekanikman avan yo te repaind linyen jòn doubl yo pou evite diskontinuite wèkènd lan. Tetris, videojwèn ki fèy nan 1984 pa Alexey Pajitnov, te vin yon referans kiltirel pou incident sa a. Non li vini nan 'tetramino' — yon form ki fèt ak kat karè ki konekte — ak 'tenis,' lòt prefere Pajitnov. Melodi ki fèt famèz videojwèn an vini nan chante popilè rous 19zyèm syèk 'Korobeiniki,' aranjé pa Hirokazu Tanaka. Fenomèn ki rele 'Effè Tetris' — kote aktivite repetitif yo kòmanse afekte pankè ak rêv yo — te jwe pou yon referans amusant pa témoin yo.

article_content: Joanna Abernethy, a 53-year-old high school teacher from Canberra, Australia, was tragically killed on Saturday morning while cycling across the United States to honor Martin Luther King Jr. Her body was found at 3:38 a.m. local time on the side of US-40 in eastern Indiana—just 500 miles from her destination, Washington DC. Abernethy had begun her 7,200-kilometer solo journey on May 7 in Astoria, Oregon, planning to arrive in the nation’s capital on August 14. Though not an experienced cyclist, she trained diligently, initially borrowing her teenage daughter Orly’s Malvern Star bike before upgrading to a dedicated Vivente touring model. Along the way, she connected with kind strangers through the Warm Showers Organization, a global network that offers hospitality to traveling cyclists. One such person was Frank Briscoe, a Missouri-based cyclist who met Abernethy on July 31. Despite knowing her for only 24 hours, Briscoe described their bond as immediate and profound. 'She was such a good person, full of determination—it was refreshing to see,' he said. Briscoe later wrote a feature article about her in the Nevada Daily Mail on August 2, moved by her mission. Days later, he learned of her death after being contacted by her half-brother, Jake, who noted that authorities are investigating whether alcohol may have been a factor. In her blog, Abernethy reflected deeply on King’s legacy: 'His courage, dignity, love, and hope created a better world for all of us. I felt compelled to pay tribute.' Her final blog entry, posted just days before departure, pondered the meaning of making a difference: 'I suppose most people would like to think they weren’t just taking up space.' The Wayne County Sheriff’s Department has launched an investigation into the incident. Clifford Henry, 24, the driver of the vehicle involved, may face criminal charges. Authorities say the probe could take several weeks before evidence is sent to prosecutors. Abernethy’s family, still reeling from the loss, are comforted by the outpouring of support from strangers whose lives she touched. Her daughter Orly, 19, is being cared for by family and friends in Canberra.
translated_content: Joanna Abernethy, yon tèt kous 53 an, profèsè nan Kanbera, Australi, te mouri trajikman samedi matin lè li te syklo pou onore Martin Luther King Jr. Li te jwenn korpa li a 3:38 a.m. loka a sou kote de US-40 nan ayistèn Indianna—sèlman 500 mil nan dènyè destinaison li, Washington DC. Abernethy te kòmanse viyaj 7,200 km li a solò a 7 may nan Astoria, Oregon, avèk yon plan pou arive nan kapital nasyonal la 14 août. Menm si li pa yon syklist ekspè, li te entrenen ak ti byen, dènye a pwojèt velò Malvern Star fi 19 an yo, ansanm avèk yon Vivente touris ki pi bon pou travay yo. Pandan viyaj la, li te konekté avèk moun ki gentil yo atravè Organizasyon Warm Showers, yon rezo global ki ofri akogman pou syklist ki travaye. Yon sèl nan yo se Frank Briscoe, yon syklist Mòzìs ki te konprann Abernethy 31 jiyè. Malgre li te konnen li pou sèlman 24 or, Briscoe te dekri lòb li kòm imedyat ak pwofond. 'Li te yon bon moun, plen de determinasyon—li te rafraîchissant de wè,' li te di. Briscoe te ekri yon artik sou li nan Nevada Daily Mail 2 août, touche pa misyon li a. Kèk jou aprè, li te aprann mort li a aprè li te kontakte pa demèt li, Jake, ki te fèt ke enkèt yo ap vire si alkol ta kapab yon faktè. Nan blòg li a, Abernethy te reflechi sou legasi King: 'Son kouraz, dignite, amou ak espwa te kreye yon moun ki pi bon pou tout nou. Mwen te resenti konsa pou fè yon tribit.' Dènye enpri a, ekri a janm devan depart la, te mande si moun kapab fè yon diferans: 'Moun an gen tendans panse yo pa sèlman pran ekipaj la.' Departman Sherif Wayne County te kòmanse enkèt sou aksidan sa a. Clifford Henry, 24, sofyan veyikil la, ka gen chimen kriminel. Otòrité yo di enkèt la ka dwe pwochen plisè wèk avant evidans yo asepte pou prosikatè yo. Famil Abernethy, toujou touche pa perd lan, te konforte pa tout akòl ki te pwodui pandan viyaj la. Fi li, Orly, 19 an, gen moun ki pran swen li nan Kanbera.

article_content: A woman, Layla bint Abdul Mutaleb Bassim, was publicly beheaded in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, after being convicted of murdering and sexually assaulting her husband’s six-year-old daughter, Kalthoum bint Abdul Rahman bin Ghulam Gadir. Graphic footage of the execution was uploaded to the internet, prompting widespread anger within Saudi Arabia—not over the punishment itself, but because the video could be seen by Bassim’s family. Saudi authorities have arrested an individual for filming the execution, though officials have not disclosed the specific charge. In the video, Bassim, dressed in black and kneeling on the pavement surrounded by police, repeatedly cried out, 'I did not kill. There is no God but God.' She continued protesting her innocence as the executioner, clad in a white robe, forced her to lie down. The executioner’s first swing failed to fully sever her head, requiring a second blow. A voice then read aloud her crime, consistent with Saudi Arabia’s traditional public executions. Bassim was among 10 people executed in Saudi Arabia so far this year. The kingdom carried out 87 executions in 2023, up from 78 in 2013, according to Amnesty International. Saudi Arabia applies the death penalty for offenses including rape, murder, apostasy, armed robbery, and drug trafficking. Officials identified Bassim as a national of Myanmar but did not confirm whether she belonged to the Rohingya community, a persecuted ethnic minority denied citizenship in Myanmar. article_content: A remarkable collection of photographs offers a rare glimpse into the daily lives of 1960s coal mining communities—both underground and beyond the pit. These retro images capture the grueling work and vibrant social lives of miners, revealing that despite harsh conditions, they found joy in community and leisure. The photos spotlight mining towns in Horden, County Durham, and Workington, Cumbria, showing miners showering off coal dust after shifts, changing in locker rooms, attending union meetings, and socializing in working men’s clubs. In Horden, miners gather to listen to speakers at a 1963 National Coal Miners’ Union meeting, still wearing their safety helmets and headlamps. Elsewhere, they enjoy drinks, play dominoes, race whippets, and tend to homing pigeons. Children are seen playing in the narrow backstreets of terraced houses, while horse-drawn carts collect garbage—a snapshot of everyday life in a coal-dependent economy. The collection, captured by award-winning photographer Patrick Ward, will be displayed at the National Coal Museum in Wakefield, West Yorkshire, until January 2015. The exhibit coincides with the release of Ward’s new book, 'Being English', which explores the quirks and character of English life during this era. Though mining was physically demanding and dangerous, these images highlight a resilient, tightly-knit community where work, family, and recreation were deeply intertwined.

article_content: By Christian Gysin for the Daily Mail and Jaya Narain for MailOnline. Two British female doctors, Dr. Barathi Ravikumar, 40, and Dr. Uma Ramalingam, 42, drowned while attempting to rescue their children from a sudden wave at Playa Paraiso beach in Tenerife. The women, who were on holiday with their families, were swept into the sea after standing on rocks near the resort around 6 p.m. yesterday. Dr. Ramalingam’s husband, Dr. Palanichamy Chandra, a 49-year-old consultant gastroenterologist, jumped into the water to help and managed to save their 10-year-old son, Hari, but could not reach his wife. Dr. Ramalingam was pronounced dead at the scene; Dr. Ravikumar was later recovered from the sea by a rescue helicopter and also declared deceased. Their 14-year-old daughter was rescued by British tourist Adam Cramer, who found her wearing only shorts and a T-shirt—not swimwear. A third adult woman in the group was saved by hotel staff and local fishermen. Hari was taken to hospital with hypothermia; the 14-year-old received treatment for cuts and bruises at the scene. Dr. Ramalingam, a consultant obstetrician registered with the General Medical Council since November 2009, worked at the Royal Oldham Hospital and other facilities within the Pennine Acute Hospitals Trust. She had previously lost her first husband, Dr. Kannan Palaniswamy, in a car crash near Dundee Hospital seven years ago. Dr. Ravikumar, a general practitioner, lived in Reepham, Lincolnshire, with her husband, Dr. Chinnusamy Ravikumar, a consultant in diabetes and endocrinology. Friends and neighbors described both women as devoted mothers and dedicated professionals. Rescue efforts included a helicopter, two ambulances, coastguards, firefighters, and local volunteers. Local police and the Guardia Civil are investigating the incident.

article_content: England and Sri Lanka played out a draw in the third and final Test at the Rose Bowl on Monday, securing a 1-0 series win for England. Persistent bad weather disrupted play for 155 overs across the first three days, and a final downpour during tea on the last day halted any further action. Sri Lanka’s captain, Kumar Sangakkara, played a crucial 119 — his 25th Test century — to guide his side to 334 for five in their second innings. This left Sri Lanka with a lead of 141 runs after England had posted 377 for eight declared in their first innings. England had already won the opening Test in Cardiff by an innings and 114 runs, followed by a draw at Lord’s. Sangakkara admitted his team’s collapse to 82 all out in Cardiff had cost them dearly. 'None of us were really switched on in Cardiff,' he said. 'We could have had a 0-0 series if we’d performed better. There’s regret, but we learned. Today, we batted with pride and walked away with a solid result.' England captain Andrew Strauss praised Sri Lanka’s disciplined batting, saying, 'We put ourselves in winning positions in all three Tests, but Sangakkara and the Sri Lankans blunted our attack. We just couldn’t make the breakthroughs we needed.' He added, 'That two-hour session in Cardiff was enough to seal the series.' With the series over, England remain third in the ICC Test rankings, behind leaders India and South Africa.

Kapitèn Srilanka, Kumar Sangakkara, te fè yon senaryo enpotan 119 — sa a se 25èm senaryo li nan Test yo — pou li menm pouse ekip la nan 334 pou 5 nan dezyèm inisyon yo. 'Pa gen okenn moun ki te reyèlman anba yon konpòtman nan Cardiff,' li te di. 'Nou te kapab gen yon seri 0-0 si nou te fè yon bon travay. Gen yon regre, men nou te aprann. Aji a, nou te batit avèk dlo nan tèt nou ak nou te kouri avèk yon rezilta ki bon.' Kapitèn Angleter Andrew Strauss te pwodui Srilanka yo pou batit yo diskiplinen, li te di, 'Nou te mete nou nan pozisyon pou gagnen tout twa Test yo, men Sangakkara ak Srilanka yo te bloke atak nou. Nou te pèdi pwen ki te nesesè a. Se twa or k apre Cardiff te sifiyan pou fè seri a.' Apre seri a fini, Angleter rete tou 3 nan klasyemman ICC Test yo, devan India ak South Africa.

article_content: Tesla's Cybertruck might not be the best vehicle for off-roading after all—at least according to recent videos. A series of clips originally posted to Instagram by @stretch_thecj2l, and later reshared by a Tesla fan account on X (formerly Twitter), appear to show several Cybertrucks struggling on sandy, steep terrain. In three videos, the electric pickup fails to gain traction climbing a hill, with tires spinning and screeching. Despite its bulletproof stainless steel exterior and optional fixed bulletproof glass windows, Elon Musk has marketed the Cybertruck as an apocalypse-proof, rugged vehicle. In one clip, the Cybertruck eventually reaches the top after 10–15 seconds of wheel-spinning, prompting an onlooker to ask, 'Is it even on?' The Instagram caption noted that three Cybertrucks were being tested at Hollister Hills, a recreational off-road area in California, and that onlookers had to demonstrate proper technique using a Jeep CJ-2A. A separate video shows the 1946 Jeep navigating the same hill effortlessly. 'Piece of cake!' the same woman says. 'That poor Tesla's broke down there.' The clips have garnered over 342,000 views on X. Another video from the same location shows a Cybertruck attempting the climb multiple times but ends before confirming success. These tests likely occurred ahead of Tesla’s scheduled Cybertruck delivery event on November 30. This isn’t the first time the Cybertruck has been seen struggling: in May, a video showed one stuck in mud in Texas. Tesla has not responded to requests for comment, though Musk has insisted the vehicle is built to be 'tough.' Auto experts warn against evaluating a vehicle based on prototype footage, especially one subjected to rigorous testing. During a recent interview with Joe Rogan, Musk clarified that the Cybertruck can raise its ride height to clear obstacles. 'In most gas or diesel trucks,' he explained, 'the differential hangs low between the rear wheels. Hit a rock, and you break it. But the Cybertruck’s underside is completely flat—it has the highest ground clearance of any vehicle.'

Nan yon videyo, Cybertruck la fin monte kòl la apre 10-15 segond de tounen, epi yon fanm ki te la di, 'Eske li anviyen?' Tesla pa reponn ak demann pou kòmantè, men Musk te deklare veyikil la te konstriyit pou 'reziste.'
